newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Beijing Bit to list A shares in Shenzhen next week.
newsitem.headline: Beijing Bit to list A shares in Shenzhen next week.

text.p: Computer components maker Beijing Bit Co Ltd will list 20 million A shares and 3.2 million staff shares on the Shenzhen bourse next Tuesday, a company spokesman said on Friday.
All of the shares will be for domestic investors.

The 20 million shares were issued at 4.76 yuan ($0.57) each through the south China bourse's automated quotation system last month. The other shares were offered to company employees at one yuan each in 1993, the spokesman told the Hong Kong-based newsletter, the China Securities Bulletin.
China Southern Securities has been named Bit's listing promoter, he said.

Prior to the A share offer, Bit had total share capital of 68.57 million shares, including 35.00 million founder shares, 20.63 million legal person -- or state institutional shares -- and 12.94 million employee shares.
Bit said in its prospectus that it would use proceeds from the offer to expand its core business and diversify into the production of household appliances.
The company said it expected after-tax profits of 27.97 million yuan this year, compared with 10.77 million yuan in 1995 and 11.33 million yuan the previous year.
Under Chinese accounting methods, it had audited net profits of 17.44 million yuan in the first half of this year. It did not give a comparative figure.
Bit was set up in Beijing in 1993 with a registered capital of 68.57 million yuan.
